operational_kpis.name: Cloud and Other Services GAAP Revenue ($M)

tooltip_definitions.Cloud and Other Services GAAP Revenue: GAAP revenue derived from Cerebras Cloud inference tokens, dedicated cluster hosting, and customer engineering support ($141.93M in Q3 2026, up +264.7% YoY, beating Street consensus $135.0M).
tooltip_definitions.Core Non-GAAP Total Revenue: Core revenue excluding non-cash warrant amortization, stock-based compensation, and data center pass-through costs ($230.90M in Q3 2026, up +70.1% YoY, beating consensus $220.0M).
tooltip_definitions.Contracted Data Center Capacity: Total energized and contracted data center power under binding multi-year delivery agreements across North America and Europe, reaching 700 megawatts (up from 600 MW in Q2 2026).
tooltip_definitions.Consolidated GAAP Revenue: Total GAAP revenue recognizing both wafer-scale hardware deliveries and cloud inference services ($210.81M in Q3 2026, up +55.3% YoY, narrowly missing consensus $214.70M by -1.81% due to warrant timing).
tooltip_definitions.Core Gross Margin: Non-GAAP gross profit margin adjusting for IPO warrant charges, standing at 41.0% in Q3 2026 (+940 bps YoY vs Q3 2025).
tooltip_definitions.Hardware System Revenue: Direct sales of CS-3 wafer-scale server clusters and rack-scale AI supercomputers to enterprise AI labs and sovereign data centers ($68.88M in Q3 2026, up +27.3% QoQ).
tooltip_definitions.Wafer-Scale Engine 3 (WSE-3): Cerebras's 4-trillion transistor monolithic silicon processor fabricated by TSMC on 5nm process, delivering 900,000 AI cores and 44GB on-chip SRAM with 21 petabytes/sec memory bandwidth.
tooltip_definitions.CS-3 AI Supercomputer: Liquid-cooled server unit packaging the WSE-3 processor, delivering 125 petaflops of AI compute in a 15U rack chassis without requiring external interconnect fabrics.
tooltip_definitions.Remaining Performance Obligations (RPO): Contractually committed future revenue backlog for hardware deliveries and multi-year cloud capacity, totaling over $25.4 billion.
tooltip_definitions.Disaggregated Inference: Pioneering architectural framework developed with AMD and AWS splitting prefill and decode stages across disparate compute nodes to maximize token throughput and minimize latency.
tooltip_definitions.OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol Integration: Tier-1 launch partnership serving OpenAI's frontier reasoning model at an unprecedented 750 tokens per second on Cerebras Cloud infrastructure.
tooltip_definitions.Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Deploy: Definitive multi-year agreement to stand up Cerebras CS-3 superclusters inside OCI data centers worldwide beginning in 2027.
tooltip_definitions.Operating Loss: GAAP operating loss of -$224.15M in Q3 2026 as heavy R&D for next-generation CS-4/CS-5 silicon ($177.84M) and global data center expansion scaled ahead of revenue.
tooltip_definitions.Research and Development: Silicon architecture engineering, next-gen chiplet design, and software stack development totaling $177.84M in Q3 2026 ($573.49M for 9M 2026).
tooltip_definitions.Capital Expenditure: Purchases of data center infrastructure, liquid cooling systems, and specialized manufacturing equipment totaling $497.19M in Q3 2026 ($1,046.06M YTD).
tooltip_definitions.Stock-Based Compensation: Non-cash equity compensation to engineers and executives, normalizing to $32.85M in Q3 2026 following Q2's post-IPO catch-up vesting.
tooltip_definitions.True Free Cash Flow: Forensic cash generation metric deducting OCF (-$341.41M), CapEx ($497.19M), and SBC ($32.85M), yielding True FCF of -$871.45M.
tooltip_definitions.Cash and Liquid Resources: Cash, cash equivalents, restricted cash, and short-term investments totaling $7.80 billion with an additional $850 million undrawn revolving credit line.
tooltip_definitions.TSMC Packaging Allocation: Direct wafer allocation and advanced silicon packaging capacity secured with TSMC, bypassing CoWoS packaging bottlenecks by utilizing monolithic wafer-scale dies.
tooltip_definitions.Breakeven Operating Margin Target: Guidance corridor targeting Core non-GAAP operating margin of (1%) to +1% in Q4 2026, marking Cerebras's imminent transition to operational profitability.
